The Router underestimated the severity of the text artifact; illegible branding is a hallmark of AI generation. I am upgrading the text artifact severity to 3.0.
alignment_reasoning: The Fine Grained Classifier strongly confirms the class 'baseball' (logit 7.93 vs 3.09 for soccer ball). The object possesses all critical geometric and functional components: spherical shape, figure-8 stitching topology, and leather texture. The 'failed' checkpoints regarding uniformity and contrast are due to the 'used' condition of the ball, which is a valid variation of the class, not an alignment error. Thus, alignment is high.
artifact_reasoning: The primary defect is the nonsensical black marking ('DA') on the ball face, identified by both Router and Image Text Auditor. Real baseballs have clear logos (MLB, Rawlings, etc.) or none; they do not have morphologically inconsistent half-letters. This is a clear AI artifact (Severity 3.0). Additionally, there is minor texture smoothing in the deep shadows (Severity 1.5) and slight loss of stitching definition in those areas. These artifacts prevent a perfect score.
